3.name: Trickery Domain Spells
3.notes: You always have the listed spells prepared at the appropriate Cleric levels. See spell_table.

3.name: Blessing of the Trickster
3.notes: As a Magic action, choose yourself or a willing creature within 30 feet. The target has Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks until you finish a Long Rest or use this feature again.

3.name: Invoke Duplicity
3.notes:
As a Bonus Action, expend Channel Divinity to create an intangible illusion of yourself in an unoccupied space within 30 feet. Lasts 1 minute unless dismissed or you become Incapacitated. The illusion mimics your actions.

Benefits while active:
• Cast Spells: You may cast spells as though you were in the illusion’s space while using your own senses.
• Distract: If both you and the illusion are within 5 feet of a creature that can see the illusion, you have Advantage on attack rolls against that creature.
• Move: As a Bonus Action, you can move the illusion up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see within 120 feet.

6.name: Trickster's Transposition
6.notes: Whenever you use the Bonus Action to create or move your Invoke Duplicity illusion, you can teleport and swap places with the illusion.

17.name: Improved Duplicity
17.notes:
Your Invoke Duplicity illusion gains additional effects:

• Shared Distraction: You and your allies have Advantage on attack rolls against any creature within 5 feet of the illusion.
• Healing Illusion: When the illusion ends, you or a creature within 5 feet of it regains Hit Points equal to your Cleric level.
